summary: Alector, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement dated October 15, 2026 with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and BTIG, LLC for a marketed follow-on offering of 36,600,000 primary shares at $2.05 per share, all sold by the Company. Gross proceeds are expected at $75,030,000 before underwriting discounts, commissions and expenses, with closing targeted for October 19, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The offering was made under an effective Form S-3 shelf and priced via a prospectus supplement; no board recommendation, premium or special-situation mechanics are involved.
